summary.text: Randy E. Smith is a Republican member of the West Virginia Senate from District 14, listed with Preston County, and serves as President of the Senate. The district covers Preston, Tucker, Grant, Hardy and Mineral counties and part of Taylor.

paragraphs.text: Smith's page lists his education as East Preston High School and his occupation as coal miner, and gives his birthplace as Oakland, Maryland.
It names his spouse as Patty Smith and lists two children, Amy J. and R. Scott.
His affiliations include the National Rifle Association, Brookside Church of the Brethren and the FFA Alumni Association and CTE Advisory Board.

As Senate President, Smith chairs the Rules Committee, and his page lists him as chair of the Government and Finance, Post Audits Subcommittee, Special Investigations and West Virginia Fusion Center Oversight committees, and as an ex officio member of the Education Accountability, Health and Human Resources Accountability and Rule-Making Review committees.
